name: 83. Gemini Chat Completions Inline Image and Audio Silently Dropped (#7032)
description: core/providers/gemini/chat.go had no case for part.InlineData in either ToBifrostChatResponse (unary) or ToBifrostChatCompletionStream (streaming), so a Gemini image-generation model's base64 output was silently dropped: HTTP 200, billed image tokens in usage.completion_tokens_details.image_tokens, and no image anywhere in the client response. Bifrost's own Responses converter and dedicated image converter already preserved this field; only Chat Completions dropped it. Each case only asserts the invariant when the model actually generated and billed an image that run, since Gemini image generation is nondeterministic and occasionally answers text only.
